title: Uniqueness of the two-coordinate tensor-chain augmentation
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, and a scheme X. Let a and b be natural transformations from the signed total tensor of complexes to the specified quotient-tensor Roos complex [lem-fix-constructible-tensor-completion]. If both satisfy IsTensorChain [def-sf-tensor-completion-comparison], then a=b. The hypotheses specify both the actual quotient pure-tensor coordinate and the zero shifted coordinate.

source.place: Coefficient presentation of the projection map; the explicit quotient augmentation is the one of Bhatt--Scholze, Definition 3.4.10 and Lemma 6.5.5, as retained in def-sf-projection-tensor-coefficient-comparison

proof.text: Fix the input complexes. Compare the first coordinate after every countable-product projection, in each degree. Total-coproduct extensionality reduces to a homogeneous tensor summand; tensor/sheafification extensionality reduces to local pure tensors, where the first normalization clause gives equality.

The second normalization clause sets both shifted coordinates to zero. The identity decomposition mappingCocone.id_X expresses every component as the sum of its first and shifted projections followed by their inclusions. Substitute the equal coordinates to get equality degreewise. Complex and natural-transformation extensionality finish.
